summary.result: The policy implication of this study is that extending the DPPRLC program to include walls and roofs in rural villages will make rural landscape more attractive.
summary.background: The Direct Payment Program for Rural Landscape Conservation (DPPRLC), introduced by the Korean government, currently offers subsidies to rural villages to encourage the growing of flower crops or wild flowers instead of common grain.
summary.method: Villagers were interviewed for a proposed direct payment program for building and maintaining traditional walls and roofs.
